testcase.name: Scenario: Dock a floating panel to an edge with a visible target preview: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-docking-system-source/features/application/docking-system/docking-system.feature:6:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Dock a floating panel to an edge with a visible target preview ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active ✔ And a dockable panel is floating over the workspace ✔ When the user drags the panel title bar toward the left workspace edge ✔ Then the left docking target is indicated before the panel is released ✔ When the user releases the panel over that target ✔ Then the panel docks along the left edge of the workspace ✔ And the viewport resizes to occupy the remaining workspace ✔ And the active part remains visible
